newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PRESTASI BUYS COMPASS FOR 20.99 MLN RAND.
newsitem.headline: PRESTASI BUYS COMPASS FOR 20.99 MLN RAND.

text.p: Prestasi Financial Services Ltd said on Monday it would buy Compass Insurance Co Ltd from Aegis Insurance Co Ltd and Sege Ltd for 20.99 million rand.
The purchase will be paid for in cash and will take effect from July 1.

Compass will be acquired through the purchase of its parent New South African Insurance Investments Ltd which is 74 percent owned by Aegis. Minority shareholder Sege holds the balance of the New South African stake.
Prestasi said the purchase was subject to the completion of a due diligence review and the approval by the Financial Services Board.
Compass, which was established in mid-1994 and is a personal lines insurer, had gross written income of 114.3 million rand in the six months to June 1996, and net income after tax of 2.8 million.
